## PR Checklist

Please ensure your Pull Request meets the following requirements:

- [ ] Commit message follows our guidelines:  
       https://github.com/catbee-technologies/catbee-docs/blob/main/.commitlintrc.mjs
- [ ] Documentation content has been checked for accuracy, formatting, and clarity
- [ ] Links and code examples have been verified
- [ ] I have run `npm run lint` and `npm run build` locally and verified all checks pass

## PR Type

- [ ] Build / Tooling (`build`)
- [ ] CI / Workflow (`ci`)

- [ ] Maintenance / Chore (`chore`)
- [ ] Other (please describe below)
